name: landing-zone-ai
description: Shared foundation for generative-AI workloads: Azure AI Services (Foundry), Azure AI Search, Key Vault, hardened Storage, and Log Analytics - all keyless and managed-identity ready.
what: A platform foundation purpose-built for GenAI: an Azure AI Services (Foundry) account for models, an Azure AI Search service for retrieval/RAG, plus the shared Key Vault, Storage, and Log Analytics every AI app needs. Local/key auth is disabled - access is via Microsoft Entra and managed identities.
why: GenAI apps (RAG chatbots, agents, copilots) repeatedly need the same backbone: a models endpoint, a vector/keyword index, durable storage for documents, a place for secrets, and centralized telemetry. Standing this up once as a governed, keyless landing zone lets every AI use case plug in without re-solving identity, networking, and observability.
potentialUseCases: Foundation for RAG chat apps and AI agents that build on top
Shared AI platform for several app teams in a business unit
Hackathon / lab environment for GenAI prototyping with guardrails
Base you extend with private endpoints + CMK for regulated AI workloads

reliability: Scaled, SLA-backed Azure AI Search in prod (replicas >= 3)
Zone-redundant storage option for document/grounding data
Regional Log Analytics for durable AI telemetry
security: Keyless: local auth disabled on AI Services and Search (Entra + managed identity only)
Key Vault (RBAC, soft delete) for any required secrets
Custom subdomain on AI Services enables token-based auth
costOptimization: Basic search + LRS storage in dev; scale up only for prod
Pay-as-you-go model consumption on AI Services
Single shared foundation amortized across many AI workloads
operationalExcellence: Centralized telemetry for models, search, and storage
Managed identities remove credential rotation toil
performanceEfficiency: Semantic ranking available for higher-quality retrieval
Regional co-location of models, search, and storage

components.name: Azure AI Search (Standard S1) x3 replicas
Log Analytics analytics logs ingestion
components.notes: Assumes ~5 GB/month telemetry. Model token usage is billed per AI use case.
